NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: APK Junk Cleaner
patches.description: Strips non-functional build metadata, compiler properties, Kotlin coroutines debug tables, and duplicate license texts from META-INF and APK root.

patches.name: Add AMOLED Theme
patches.description: Adds a selectable Pure Black AMOLED theme using Gboard's native color_black theme package, without replacing Dark, Light, System Auto, or Dynamic Color.

patches.name: Allow Modified APK
patches.description: Bypasses internal signature check to allow custom APK execution.

patches.name: Block Brave Telemetry
patches.description: Blocks P3A product analytics, Brave Stats usage pings, crash dump uploads, WDP, and Variations seed fetching.

patches.name: Block Hevy Telemetry & Trackers
patches.description: Neutralizes Sentry crash reporting, Adjust attribution, Facebook AppEvents, Branch referral tracking, and WearOS background sync.

patches.name: Block Telemetry
patches.description: Disables background metrics dispatch, event logging, daily pings, and crash reporting.

patches.name: Block Vivaldi Sync
patches.description: Redirects bifrost.vivaldi.com to 0.0.0.0 in libchrome.so to completely disable Vivaldi account synchronization for an air-gapped experience.

patches.name: Block Vivaldi Telemetry
patches.description: Blocks Vivaldi usage statistics, crash reporting, Crashpad endpoints, and DirectMatch suggestions.

patches.name: Brave In-Product & Commercial Notification Optimizer
patches.description: Eliminates background wakeups and notifications from Chromium tips scheduler (Job ID 105), Brave Rewards onboarding promo, and retention marketing campaigns.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin and enables local feature toggle controls.

patches.name: Brave Startup Performance Optimization
patches.description: Optimizes startup time and eliminates background CPU/disk overhead by disabling unused OEM carrier partner customizations.

patches.name: Clean Share URL
patches.description: Strips tracking parameters, user IDs, device fingerprints, and marketing tokens from shared TikTok links.

patches.name: Clean Speed Dial Bookmarks
patches.description: Removes sponsored commercial affiliate bookmarks, hides the 3-dot customize button, and disables phantom touch actions on the blank Start Page.

patches.name: Clipboard Enhancements
patches.description: Extends unpinned clipboard history retention duration, raises the maximum number of displayed unpinned clips, and allows customizing keyboard grid columns.

options.title: Unpinned clip limit
options.description: Maximum number of unpinned clipboard history items to display in the UI (default: 50, range: 5..100).

options.title: Retention time limit (hours)
options.description: Number of hours to retain unpinned clips in history before automatic cleanup (e.g. 12, 24 for 1 day, 48 for 2 days, 168 for 7 days. Default: 24).

options.title: Clipboard grid columns
options.description: Number of columns in the clipboard keyboard layout (1, 2, or 3. Default: 2).

patches.name: Clone Gboard
patches.description: Changes the package name by appending a dot and custom suffix (defaults to 'clone') to allow installing Gboard alongside the original application.

options.title: Package name suffix
options.description: Suffix appended after the original package name and a dot (e.g. 'clone' -> 'com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.clone').

patches.name: Close Tabs on Exit
patches.description: Prevents tab restoration on startup, ensuring Vivaldi always opens with a clean Start Page session regardless of how the app was terminated.

patches.name: Core Asset De-bloat
patches.description: Strips embedded Microblink credit card OCR models, C2PA AI content origin verification libraries, and redundant non-Latin fonts to save APK space.

patches.name: DPI Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected screen density resource directories from res/ (e.g. drawable-mdpi, drawable-hdpi, mipmap-xhdpi). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and orphan resources are safely preserved.

options.title: DPI densities to keep
options.description: Comma-separated screen densities to preserve (e.g. 'xxhdpi', 'xhdpi, xxhdpi', 'xxxhdpi'). Density-independent resources (nodpi, anydpi) and unquantified base directories are always preserved.

patches.name: Device Privacy Guard
patches.description: Neutralizes background clipboard snooping routines and blocks screenshot/recording detection listeners to protect user data from unauthorized tracking and popup modals.

patches.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches.description: Eliminates background wakeups, radio modem activity, and battery drain by forcing GooglePlayServicesChecker.shouldDisableBackgroundSync() -> true and neutralizing wakeup tasks.

patches.name: Disable Background Sync & Periodic Sync
patches.description: Prevents Web Background Sync and Periodic Sync APIs from scheduling wakeups and background tasks in Android JobScheduler.

patches.name: Disable Battery Status API & OS Listener
patches.description: Neutralizes the Battery Status API (navigator.getBattery) to prevent cross-site device fingerprinting and drops OS battery change broadcasts.

patches.name: Disable Chromium Tips & Notification Scheduler
patches.description: Eliminates periodic background wakeups, native library loading, and in-product promotional tips from Chromium tips scheduler.

patches.name: Disable Diagnostics
patches.description: Disables Google's diagnostic and recovery telemetry.

patches.name: Disable Google Primes
patches.description: Neutralizes Google Primes performance profiling, jank monitoring, native crash sidecars, and background telemetry threads.

patches.name: Disable MDD Background Sync
patches.description: Neutralizes Mobile Data Download (MDD) periodic background synchronization, automated polling, and prefetch worker tasks while preserving on-demand and user-requested downloads.

patches.name: Disable Push Notifications
patches.description: Neutralizes background push notification tasks and persistent socket wake locks to eliminate background battery drain.

patches.name: Disable Remote Configuration
patches.description: Disables periodic remote experiment flag synchronization and background updates.

patches.name: Disable Superpacks Eager Sync
patches.description: Neutralizes eager background Superpacks synchronization during application startup, eliminating unnecessary disk sweeps and network polling while preserving on-demand pack downloads.

patches.name: Disable Tenor Share Tracking
patches.description: Disables Tenor GIF selection and share tracking telemetry.

patches.name: Disable Vivaldi Prompts & In-App Popups
patches.description: Disables in-app donation prompts, search engine switch promos, rate-app popups, background privacy report alarms, and default browser promotional handlers.

patches.name: Disable WorkManager
patches.description: Neutralizes background WorkManager initialization, database creation, and periodic maintenance workers.

patches.name: Enable Access Points Menu Redesign
patches.description: Enables the redesigned access points menu bar and customization panel (Panel V2).

patches.name: Enable Key Shape Selection
patches.description: Enables the key border shape selection UI (Default, Semi-rounded, Round) in theme customization.

patches.name: Feed Ad Blocker
patches.description: Removes sponsored advertisements, brand promotions, and promotional audio from the For You and Following feeds.

patches.name: Feed Live Stream Blocker
patches.description: Removes live stream broadcast cards and live recommendations from the For You and Following feeds.

patches.name: Force Incognito Mode
patches.description: Forces Gboard to always operate in incognito mode (disabling personalized learning and persistent input logging) while keeping clipboard functionality enabled.

patches.name: Hardened Intent Security
patches.description: Enables Gboard internal external intent protection against unauthorized intent hijacking.

patches.name: Hevy Battery Optimization & Background Sync Killer
patches.description: Disables background WorkManager alarms, periodic job schedulers, Google Play Billing IPC (~89 MB RAM), and removes largeHeap to force aggressive Garbage Collection.

patches.name: Hevy Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips embedded onboarding MP4 tutorial video, heavy IMG.LY photo editor stickers/textures, and compiler junk metadata.

patches.name: Hide TikTok Shop Anchors
patches.description: Removes product showcase badges, shopping cart tags, and TikTok Shop commercial anchors from video posts in the feed.

patches.name: Instant Launch & Splash Blocker
patches.description: Eliminates cold startup delays, real-time splash advertisements, and background TopView preloading (<0.4s launch).

patches.name: Language Pack Purger
patches.description: Strips unselected language string bundles from assets/strings#lang_* to save APK space.

options.title: Languages to keep
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to keep (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English ('en') is always preserved as safe fallback.

patches.name: Live Stream 3D Gift Optimizer
patches.description: Disables Live 3D gift particle effect engine and widget rendering lifecycle to eliminate frame drops during live streams.

patches.name: Live Stream SDK & Minigame De-bloat
patches.description: Strips Live link mic SDK (liblink_mic_sdk.so) and live stream interactive minigames to save APK storage.

patches.name: Locale PAK Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected language resource PAKs from assets/locales/.

options.title: Locales to keep
options.description: Comma-separated locale codes to keep (e.g. 'es, es-419, en-US, pt-BR, fr, de'). English (en-US) is always kept as a safe fallback.

patches.name: Locale Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unselected language translation directories from res/ (e.g. values-*, raw-*, xml-*). Base fallback resources with no language qualifiers are always preserved.

options.title: Locales to keep
options.description: Comma-separated language codes to preserve (e.g. 'en, es, pt, fr, de'). English fallback is always retained.

patches.name: Media Usability & Watermark-Free Downloader
patches.description: Enables progress seekbar scrubbing on all videos, unblocks the download button on creator-restricted videos, and routes downloads to clean unwatermarked media streams.

patches.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches.description: Strips unused native companion binaries (Impress Vision AI, WireGuard VPN, and Android XR) to significantly reduce APK size.

patches.name: PNG Asset Optimizer
patches.description: Losslessly recompresses PNG assets with maximum zlib compression and strips non-rendering metadata chunks (pHYs, tEXt, tIME) while preserving 9-patch structures and pixel accuracy.

patches.name: Playback Speed Persistence
patches.description: Persists selected video playback speed across all feed videos and application restarts.

patches.name: Resource & Battery Governor
patches.description: Throttles background sensor polling (gyroscope/accelerometer 3D ads), prevents aggressive video buffer preloading, and caps Fresco animated image memory retention to conserve battery and RAM.

patches.name: Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips embedded third-party license text, onboarding tutorial Lottie animations, promotional GIFs, and APK root metadata/junk files.

patches.name: Resource Slimmer
patches.description: Strips bundled stock wallpapers and sponsored Speed Dial thumbnails to reduce APK size.

patches.name: Skip First Run
patches.description: Skips the welcome screen, search engine selection, and onboarding First Run Experience (FRE) on clean installs.

patches.name: Studio & Creation De-bloat
patches.description: Strips heavy video creation, CapCut-like video editor SDK (libttvesdk_plugin.so), and AR camera face models to save over 22MB.

patches.name: Unified Telemetry & Tracker Silencer
patches.description: Neutralizes ByteDance AppLog user tracking, APM/Npth/Heimdallr crash monitors, AppsFlyer attribution, and Firebase analytics.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks local Hevy Pro capabilities (unlimited workout routines, routine folders, advanced graphs, and local analytics) by dynamically enabling Pro getters in Hermes Bytecode (HBC96).

patches.name: Update Prompt Suppressor
patches.description: Neutralizes background update polling tasks and device ID check routines to prevent forced update popups.

patches.name: Vivaldi Startup Performance Optimization
patches.description: Guards against fatal CompositorView NullPointerException crashes on cold startup and bypasses carrier partner customizations.
